hero.name: Karol Malina
hero.bio: Ambitious, certified IT technician with outstanding vocational exam results (100% & 97% practical scores), focused on modern web technologies. I have hands-on experience in independently designing and deploying Full-Stack applications using Next.js, JavaScript, and TailwindCSS. Thanks to advanced AI-assisted development tools, I can significantly optimize my coding workflow.

projects.title: Selected Works
projects.intro: Two projects designed, built and shipped end to end on my own — interface, backend and CMS included.

items.title: Malinowe Zdrowie
items.description: A responsive Full-Stack landing page built with Next.js, featuring a fully custom blog system and a dedicated admin CMS panel for easy content management without touching the source code. Styled with TailwindCSS, Radix UI, and shadcn/ui.

items.title: Szybkie Jedzenie v2
items.description: An AI-powered restaurant discovery platform — users describe what they are looking for and the AI matches them with ideal venues in seconds, analyzing menus, reviews and ambiance. Built with a Next.js frontend, custom TailwindCSS component architecture, and a backend API integration.

items.title: The Beginning
items.description: Began my IT education at the Vocational Training Center in Wadowice. I discovered my passion for programming and started learning the fundamentals of computer systems, networks, and web technologies.

items.title: Certified Excellence
items.description: Passed the professional INF.02 exam (Administration of computer systems) with 100% on the practical part, and INF.03 (Web & database development) with 97% on the practical part — proving a strong, hands-on command of IT fundamentals.

items.title: Into the Modern Web
items.description: Dove deep into the modern web ecosystem. Fell in love with Next.js, TailwindCSS, and component-driven architecture. Built and deployed my first real Full-Stack project: 'Malinowe Zdrowie' — a landing page with a custom CMS admin panel.

items.title: Ready for the Industry
items.description: Actively developing my portfolio with projects like the geolocation food app 'Szybkie Jedzenie v2'. Leveraging AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to write better code faster. Seeking my first professional role in the IT industry.

stack.title: Languages & Skills
stack.intro: A practical stack I use to design, build and ship full-stack web apps on my own — interface, data and CMS included.

languages.name: HTML5 & CSS3
languages.longDesc: Strong command of semantic HTML5 and modern CSS3. I write accessible, well-structured markup and craft custom styling solutions that go beyond utility frameworks when needed.

languages.name: JavaScript
languages.longDesc: My main language for building interactive web applications. I use modern ES6+ features to write clean, efficient logic for both frontend and backend environments within the Next.js ecosystem.

languages.name: SQL (MySQL)
languages.longDesc: Experienced in designing relational database schemas and writing queries with MySQL. Applied in project backends to store and manage structured application data.

languages.name: Python
languages.longDesc: Used for scripting, data processing, and backend logic. Familiar with core Python concepts and its application in web-related tasks and automation workflows.

skills.name: Next.js
skills.longDesc: My go-to framework for building modern web applications. I use Next.js for server-side rendering, static generation, API routes, and building full-stack solutions from a single codebase.

skills.name: TailwindCSS & shadcn/ui
skills.longDesc: Crafting pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces rapidly using TailwindCSS utility classes combined with the accessible, composable shadcn/ui and Radix UI component library.

skills.name: Supabase & MySQL
skills.longDesc: Using Supabase as a modern, scalable backend-as-a-service for authentication, real-time data, and storage, alongside MySQL for relational database design in full-stack projects.

skills.name: AI-Assisted Development
skills.longDesc: Proficient in leveraging cutting-edge AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code to dramatically speed up development, enforce best practices, and tackle complex architectural challenges.

contact.title: Let's work
contact.intro: Fresh graduate. Certified IT technician. I design, build and ship Next.js apps on my own — and I am looking for my first junior frontend / full-stack role.

hero.name: Karol Malina
hero.bio: Ambitny, dyplomowany technik informatyk z wybitnymi wynikami z egzaminów zawodowych (praktyka zdana na 100% i 97%), ukierunkowany na nowoczesne technologie webowe. Posiadam praktyczne doświadczenie w samodzielnym projektowaniu i wdrażaniu aplikacji Full-Stack z wykorzystaniem Next.js, JavaScript oraz TailwindCSS. Dzięki zaawansowanej znajomości narzędzi AI dla programistów potrafię znacząco optymalizować czas pisania kodu.

projects.title: Wybrane Projekty

items.title: Malinowe Zdrowie
items.description: Responsywna aplikacja webowa typu Full-Stack zbudowana w Next.js. Zawiera w pełni autorski system blogowy oraz dedykowany panel administratora CMS, umożliwiający zarządzanie treścią bez ingerencji w kod. Stylizowana z użyciem TailwindCSS, Radix UI i shadcn/ui.

items.title: Szybkie Jedzenie v2

items.title: Nowoczesny Web Development
items.description: Zanurzyłem się w nowoczesnym ekosystemie webowym. Zakochałem się w Next.js, TailwindCSS i architekturze komponentowej. Zbudowałem i wdrożyłem swój pierwszy prawdziwy projekt Full-Stack: 'Malinowe Zdrowie' — landing page z autorskim panelem CMS.

items.title: Gotowy na Branżę
